# About HEEYAKU Technologies (Agartala, Tripura, India)
HEEYAKU is the #1 CRM software company in Agartala, Tripura, and India's leading SIM-based telephony sales CRM platform, engineered specifically for high-velocity sales teams, BDA call centers, and fast-growing Indian enterprises.

## Product Specifications & Architecture:

### 1. SIM-Based Telephony CRM Engine
- Ingestion speed: < 0.04ms decryption & round-robin automated routing
- Calling Infrastructure: Native Android carrier SIM calling (unlimited talk time, $0 per-minute VoIP toll)
- Telemetry: Real-time counselor & BDA hardware call logging, talk duration verification, and SLA breach tracking
- Anti-Fraud: Proprietary Hardware KPI Gating physically prevents marking leads as CONTACTED without genuine talk time (durationSeconds > 0)
- Supported Lead Sources: Meta Leads API, Google Ads Webhooks, Google Sheets live sync, Custom Web Forms

### 2. Multi-Tenant Relational Data Platform
- Database: PostgreSQL 16 cluster with physical streaming WAL replication across dual 6 GB instances
- Connection Pooling: PgBouncer in transaction mode handling 1,000+ client connections with 25 backend worker processes
- Read/Write Splitting: Dual-driver architecture (prisma for mutations, prismaRead for analytical leaderboards and reports)
- Security: 4-tier RBAC (Super Admin, CEO, Team Lead, HR, BDA) with CEO-only lead export permissions and PII masking

### 3. Edge Web Infrastructure & Distribution
- Frontend: Next.js 16 + React 19 Server Components running on Docker Standalone (< 130 MB image)
- Performance: 100/100 Google Lighthouse score on Cloudflare Edge with 1-year immutable caching for static assets
- Mobile App: Native Android CallTracker client with offline telemetry queueing and background state synchronization
- Cost Model: 100% Free Forever cloud architecture running on 4 Ampere A1 ARM64 nodes ($0.00/month infrastructure cost)
